plugins.name: flowy
plugins.description: Build on Webflow with Claude Code. Routes every task to the right hand (Webflow MCP, the Chrome-driven Designer, or clipboard paste), enforces publish and destructive-operation guards as hooks, and ships a field manual of observed Webflow MCP behaviour where every claim carries a date.

skills.name: flowy-manual
skills.description: Use when building on Webflow and you need to know what is actually true — a verified-only field manual of directly-observed behaviours, traps, schema quirks and fixes. Covers what changed in MCP 2.0.1, element and style traps, CMS bindings and Collection Lists, components and props, responsive breakpoints, Designer-canvas behaviours, and live diagnostic probes. Use alongside the flowy skill (which hand) and flowy-verify (did it land).
headings: The one rule for this manual
skills.description_zh: 为 Webflow 开发提供仅基于直接观察验证的手册，记录 MCP 2.0.1 变化、元素与样式陷阱、CMS 绑定、Collection Lists、组件属性、响应断点、设计画布行为及诊断探针，配合 flowy 路由和验证技能。

skills.name: flowy-verify
skills.description: Use after a batch of Webflow MCP writes (data_whtml_builder, data_element_builder, data_element_tool, data_element_settings_tool, data_style_tool, data_cms_tool, data_component_tool, data_component_props_tool, data_component_variants_tool, data_variable_tool, data_scripts_tool, asset_tool, data_sites_tool publish) to verify the writes actually landed — catching silently-dropped classes, Webflow-injected style defaults, bindings that only look broken, and stale live-page state. A PostToolUse hook shipped with the flowy plugin reminds the agent to invoke this skill.
headings: Step 2 — Injected style defaults (if new Designer styles were auto-created)
Step 4 — Element tree (after any tree change)
Step 5 — Embed code (if an embed was written)
Step 6 — Live-page diagnostic (only after an authorized publish)
skills.description_zh: 在 Webflow MCP 批量写入元素、样式、CMS、组件、变量、脚本、素材或发布后独立核验实际落地，检查被静默丢弃的类、平台注入默认样式、表面异常绑定和陈旧线上页面。

skills.name: flowy
skills.description: Use when starting or planning ANY Webflow build, design, styling, layout, CMS, component, or edit task — before choosing tools — and the moment you are about to reach for a Webflow MCP write tool to do VISUAL or detail work. Owns which-hand routing (Webflow MCP vs the Chrome-driven Designer), the session lifecycle for both new builds and already-built sites, and the paste-first rule for third-party components. Invoke FIRST, before flowy-manual or flowy-verify.
skills.description_zh: 作为 Webflow 构建、设计、样式、布局、CMS、组件与编辑任务入口，选择 MCP 或 Chrome Designer 操作路径，管理新建和既有站点会话，并规定第三方组件优先粘贴的流程。
